caseNameFull: Frank W. Keeler v. Stanley Myers, District Attorney, etc., and Thomas M. Hurlburt, Sheriff
attorneys: Mr. Peter Q. Nyce, with whom Mr. Martin L. Pipes was on the brief, for plaintiff in error., Mr. Stanley Myers was on the brief- for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Writ of error dismissed for want of jurisdiction under § 237 of the Judicial Code as amended by the Act of February 13,' 1925 (43 Stat. 936); and, the Court treating the writ of error as an application for-certiorari, denies the cer-tiorari.
